name: peer-chat
description: Two coding agents hold a conversation as equals in one agterm split, each typing into the other's composer: Claude Code and Codex, two Claudes or two Codexes, any model on either side. Either agent opens the other pane itself (codex on gpt-6-astra by default, any harness and model by flag) when a decision would benefit from an adversary: a design with two defensible options, a diagnosis nobody has tried to disprove, a diff about to ship unreviewed. One skill body for every harness and no fixed roles: the peers agree who owns which files. Vendors umputun/agterm's two-agent-chat engine (MIT) behind a pane-identity adapter and adds the spawn step, an installer, an upstream sync script, and a conversation contract: emoji-ledger messages of any length the user can follow, every thought in the chat and only scripts, outputs and data under tmp/peer-chat/<slug>/, an ask ledger the paste script enforces (each question gets an id, the peer's next send must answer, defer or decline it), proofs through the plan plugin instead of agreed readings, and a proof handshake: 'fixed' quotes the re-run of the peer's own proof. Requires the agterm terminal 0.24.0+ (macOS), python3, jq, and the claude or codex CLI.
